subject: Quality Assurance & Testing
title: Defense in Depth
description: A 60-second lesson on Defense in Depth.

hook.text: A firewall is the only protection. An attacker bypasses it and has unrestricted access to everything.

buildup.text: A single security layer creates a single point of failure. Bypass it and the system is wide open.

discovery.text: Defense in depth layers multiple controls: firewall, auth, encryption, logging, and least privilege.

twist.text: Each layer doesn't need to be perfect. Together, they make successful attacks exponentially harder.

climax.text: An attacker bypasses the firewall but is stopped by authentication, then encryption, then access controls.

punchline.text: One lock is a challenge. Five locks are a deterrent.

quiz.question: What is the principle of defense in depth?
